== Source recheck ==
Correction to the earlier published-spelling claim: both sources are partial slips covering the lower panel, not the host title. The release caption says “Nizuk”, but the physical [[Nizuc Bek]] host title remains visible and the master caption says “Nizuc”. No changed game text or physical title has been established. The separate original-state claim has therefore been withdrawn; the misspelling redirects here. The unused 1230_16o label is retained only as an alias, not as evidence of another playable version. Sources: [[:File:VB3-16-Nizuk_Bek.png|release slip]], [[:File:VL-history-1230-16-front-master.png|master slip]].
